apps.name: NCOM Music
apps.subtitle: Save songs into Sessions. Stream them with no ads.
apps.localizedDescription: A music player. Share a YouTube or song link into NCOM Music and it saves it into a Session, then streams it with no ads. Play your own lossless files (FLAC, ALAC, WAV). Songs with a music video get a full-screen video canvas behind the player.
